items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: I don't think he ever became greater in his capabilities and things than with that John Kirby quartet.

ctx.x: John Kirby. Russell was terrific. I don't think he ever became greater in his capabilities and things than with that John Kirby quartet. And you can get some of those records today and they're beautifully put together. Beautiful instrumentations, beautiful arrangements, and beautifully played. That was really one of the famous groups of its day.
Well Russell wasn't given a great deal to do except just be part of the section, wasn't he. I mean he had an occasional solo?
